headline: Committee to review Community Survey results on possible renewal of Cape Ann Cable Franchise Agreements with Comcast.
summary: The committee will select a chair, hear a presentation from 1623 Studios on the Community Survey done for the Ascertainment Process, and discuss possible renewal of the Cape Ann Cable Franchise Agreements with Comcast. Public input on the survey or other cable TV topics, excluding programming and rates, will be taken.

# Cape Ann Regional Cable Advisory Committee

## Public Meeting

### Wednesday, October 21, 2026 - 6:00 p.m.

1623 Studios
11 Pleasant Street
Gloucester, MA 01930

## AGENDA

- Determine which member will chair the Committee.
- Presentation from 1623 Studios concerning Community Survey completed as part of the Ascertainment Process for the possible renewal of Cape Ann Cable Franchise Agreements with Comcast.
- Committee discussion regarding the survey presentation and results.
- Public input concerning the survey or any other cable TV-related topics, excluding programming and rates.
- Discussion concerning next steps.
- Items not known to the Chairman in advance of the meeting posting deadline.
- Adjourn.
